description: Search the web with AgentSearch and return the response as pretty-printed JSON text. Use this when you have a query and need hits rather than a page body; if you already have a URL, use agentsearch_extract instead (or agentsearch_render for JavaScript-heavy pages). Default mode: calls the Pocket Network Agentic Portal and PAYS $0.005 in USDC on Base per call over x402 from the wallet in AGENTSEARCH_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY (or POCKET_PRIVATE_KEY), never more than $0.005 per call and never more than AGENTSEARCH_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC per session (default $1.00); the result includes the payment receipt and the portal envelope {portal, data}, whose data is untrusted third-party content. If AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL is set, calls your self-hosted AgentSearch API instead (no payment). With neither set (no config), agentsearch_web_search uses the free AgentSearch relay (https://relay.agentsearchhq.com, 25 searches per day per user, no payment), while agentsearch_extract and agentsearch_render make no network call and explain how to add a wallet. Read-only: not destructive, but it uses the network and can hit rate limits (on the free relay, a 429 means the daily limit was reached; the error says how to upgrade to paid). Integers for max_results outside 1–5 are clamped (default 5), not rejected.

max_results.description: How many hits to request (1–5, default 5). Values outside that range are clamped.

query.description: Keywords or a natural-language question to search for.

name: agentsearch_web_search
title: AgentSearch Web Search
